postal_system.full_code_name: Akrotiri BFPO route and Cyprus postal sector
postal_system.assignment_rule: Current GOV.UK evidence maps Akrotiri to BFPO 57 and shadow postcode BF1 2AT. Cyprus DLS separately publishes one Akrotiri postal-sector Polygon for 4640. These are separate authority assertions and do not establish equivalence, XU coverage or BFPO area geometry.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Only a rights-cleared fixed Cyprus postal-sector geometry whose current postal-operator assignment and XU/BFPO relationship are explicitly reconciled may be drawn. Name equality, containment, XU territory, the combined Sovereign Base Areas, administrative or environmental maps, offices, addresses, points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never establish a postal perimeter.
postal_system.address_rule: BFPO routing, shadow-postcode equivalence, Cyprus postal assignment, DLS postal-sector membership, XU identity, address and service state remain separate assertions.
postal_system.building_rule: Building output requires a separately sourced explicit distributable address-building relationship or common authoritative identifier.
postal_system.administrative_rule: XU remains distinct from Cyprus, Dhekelia, Episkopi, Ayios Nikolaos and the combined Sovereign Base Areas. Source identities and territories are not changed, merged or relabelled.
postal_system.service_status_rule: BFPO eligibility, route/office state and delivery service are time-stamped assertions separate from area membership and deliverability.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> rights-cleared operator-reconciled postal area or explicit non-area -> address graph -> explicit building relation -> AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: normalized BFPO 57, BF1 2AT or 4640 -> authority-specific assignment and exception evidence -> valid official/derived/virtual area or explicit non-area -> address context -> explicit building relation -> AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: explicit distributable relation, common authoritative identifier, or reviewed crosswalk required

quality_gates.pass: BFPO 57, BF1 2AT and 4640 retain exact authority, normalization, equivalence and non-equivalence semantics.
Current complete BFPO eligibility/routing plus Cyprus Post assignment, alias, exception and explicit non-area denominators are fixed with dates, digests and correction policy.
Every supported value is reconciled by postal authority to one eligible DLS postal sector or a source-grounded non-area reason; Akrotiri name equality alone is insufficient.
XU, Cyprus, Dhekelia, Episkopi, Ayios Nikolaos and combined SBA identities remain distinct.
Every drawable record is finite, closed and valid Polygon/MultiPolygon in a declared CRS with lineage, class, date, confidence and exceptions.
Assignment and geometry resources pin processing, storage, derivation, redistribution, public-serving and attribution permission.
Synthetic fixtures and shared code capability never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

The current complete Akrotiri BFPO 57 and BF1 2AT routing/eligibility denominator plus Cyprus Post 4640 assignment, alias, exception and explicit non-area denominator is pinned under reviewed rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Every normalized value is explicitly reconciled to a fixed DLS or other official/right-cleared finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose authority, operator relationship, official/derived/virtual class, provider, edition, reference date, rights, attribution, bytes, SHA-256, schema, CRS, topology, coverage, method, confidence and exceptions are recorded, or retains a source-grounded route, office, P.O.-box, organization, point or other non-area reason. The DLS Akrotiri/4640 sector, Akrotiri or combined SBA territory, administrative/environmental maps, offices, addresses, buildings, parcels, points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never become BFPO 57, BF1 2AT or XU postal perimeters merely by name or containment; XU, Cyprus, Dhekelia, Episkopi and Ayios Nikolaos identities are not changed or merged. The approved immutable artifact drives the real XU API/app, which normalizes all supported forms, handles loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and displays selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.
Explicit address identifiers and points pass rights, schema, coverage, validity, privacy and correction gates.
Postal surfaces and building joins pass topology, ambiguity, identifier, rights and quality gates.
